# Nicola Mustone

> Nicola Mustone is a support team lead, web developer, writer, and maker. This portfolio covers his experience and independent projects in software, tabletop gaming, publishing, and the web.

The site is the canonical overview of Nicola's current work and career. Project pages describe what each project does, why it exists, and the technology behind it.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://nicolamustone.com/): Introduction, featured projects, and condensed work experience.
- [About Nicola](https://nicolamustone.com/about/): Biography, skills, career statistics, and full work history.

## Projects

- [OpenFray.app](https://nicolamustone.com/openfray-app/): Free, open-source D&D 5e combat console for Game Masters.
- [Agent Skills](https://nicolamustone.com/agent-skills/): Reusable coding-agent workflows for development, editorial work, and games.
- [BUT. Honestly](https://nicolamustone.com/but-honestly/): Long-form essays about leadership, software, AI, and the web.
- [shotlist](https://nicolamustone.com/shotlist/): Declarative, repeatable, annotated UI screenshots with drift detection.
- [OpenDice and Rollful](https://nicolamustone.com/opendice-rollful/): JavaScript dice-expression engine, hosted API, and browser interface.
- [MediEvil.org](https://nicolamustone.com/medievil-org/): Fan-made guide to the wider MediEvil community and its resources.
- [Carbonara.Rocks](https://nicolamustone.com/carbonara-rocks/): Guide to authentic Italian carbonara and practical ingredient substitutions.
- [NicolaMustone.blog](https://nicolamustone.com/nicolamustone-blog/): Archived WordPress and WooCommerce notes spanning more than a decade.

## Optional

- [Privacy](https://nicolamustone.com/privacy/): How the site handles analytics, visitor data, and external links.
